# lab-authored-secret

A value a human or an external system authored, held in a lab store.

<!-- Generated by nix/floe-docs.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-docs -->

## Inputs

| input | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| hostPaths | attribute set of string | `{}` | Keys to write to the host during `cata lab up`'s preflight, before any service starts. `$LAB_STATE_DIR` expands to the lab's state directory.  A key named `*.crt` is written 0644 and everything else 0600 — the CLI decides on the suffix, not on `kind`, so a file that must be world-readable has to be named for it.  |
| keys | attribute set of (submodule) | `{}` | The keys this secret holds. |
| kind | one of "value", "ca" | `"value"` | `ca` mints a self-signed certificate and key together, and always carries `ca.crt` and `ca.key` — together, because the certificate is signed by that key and generating them separately does not compose.  |

## Requires

| hole | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| labStore | [LAB_SECRET_STORE](../signatures/LAB_SECRET_STORE.md) | A store on the operator's machine that `cata` reads authored secret values from. |

## Provides

| provision | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| labSecret | [LAB_SECRET](../signatures/LAB_SECRET.md) | A secret the lab holds on the operator's machine, and the keys a cluster may read from it. |

## What it emits

Rendered by `every-floe` as the lab unit `externaldns-tsig`. A unit of the lab
installs nothing into a cluster, and its provisions are sealed inside the
lab's inclusion — so its declaration above is its interface.
